description: Mammoth browser bundle used by legacy flows (DOCX to HTML conversion).

description: pdf.js main browser bundle used by legacy flows and by the V4 same-origin lazy loader (PDF text extraction).
notes: Derived deterministic esbuild IIFE build (global `pdfjsLib`, the classic-script API the V4 loader expects) from the installed pdfjs-dist 4.10.38 `legacy/build/pdf.mjs` (upstream 4.x ships ESM only). Reproduction: `./node_modules/.bin/esbuild node_modules/pdfjs-dist/legacy/build/pdf.mjs --bundle --format=iife --global-name=pdfjsLib --platform=browser --target=es2022 --minify --outfile=lib/pdf.min.js` with the lockfile-pinned pdfjs-dist 4.10.38 and esbuild 0.28.2; the build is byte-deterministic. Embedded version literal '4.10.38' matches the worker below. Fixes CVE-2024-4367 (GHSA-wgrm-67xf-hhpq) present in the previous 3.11.174 bundle.

description: pdf.js worker bundle used by legacy flows and by the V4 same-origin lazy loader (PDF parsing off the main thread).
notes: Byte-exact copy of the installed `node_modules/pdfjs-dist/legacy/build/pdf.worker.min.mjs` from pdfjs-dist 4.10.38 (same bytes as the upstream npm tarball entry). Upstream 4.x ships the worker as an ES module; the existing filename is kept because pdf.js instantiates it as a same-origin module worker (`new Worker(src, { type: 'module' })`) and `.js` is served as JavaScript MIME. Embedded version literal '4.10.38' matches pdf.min.js.
